product_info.name: GlowMist Hydration Serum
product_info.description: A lightweight facial serum designed to improve hydration and give the skin a brighter, dewier appearance.
product_info.main_benefit: Makes skin look more hydrated and fresh quickly
use_cases: quick glow boost before going out
product_info.offer_details: Buy one, get 20% off the second bottle this week
objection_notes: Will it actually make a visible difference?
Do I really need another serum?

target_audience.demographics: Women ages 18-30 who care about fresh-looking skin, light makeup prep, and easy skincare routines

creative_goal: Turn the serum concept into a short TikTok-style storyboard that feels natural, shows visible application and glow result, and supports product clicks.
reference_script: If your skin has been looking so dull lately, this is the one thing that’s been helping mine. It’s this lightweight serum, and I’ve been using it right before makeup or anytime my skin looks tired. It sinks in really fast and doesn’t leave my skin feeling heavy or sticky. It just makes my skin look way more fresh and hydrated almost right away. If you want that easy glow without the heavy feel, tap to check it out.
creator_style: natural, relatable, friendly, lightly excited, not over-scripted

compliance_notes: Avoid exaggerated medical or dermatological claims.
production_limits: simple bathroom or bedroom vanity environment

notes: This is a sample storyboard-planning input for a direct-response beauty UGC short video.
